acquisition_method.evidence: Data were acquired using a data-dependent acquisition (DDA) method with a mass range of 350–2,000 m/z and a resolution of 500,000 using the Xcalibur software 2.2.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Parental HCT116 cells and HCT116 cells expressing Ub-GFP or Ub-GFP-tail were lysed in buffer A (50 mM Tris-HCl, pH 7.5, 100 mM NaCl, 10% glycerol, 10 mM iodoacetamide (Sigma-Aldrich)) containing 0.2% NP-40, 10 μM bortezomib, 10 μM PR619 (LifeSensors) and complete protease inhibitor cocktail (Roche, EDTA-free).
Proteins were first reduced and alkylated using 10 mM DTT (10 min, 70 °C) and 15 mM IAA (15 min, room temperature, dark), followed by binding to beads in 50% ethanol.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Protein samples were subjected to trypsin digestion using the SP3 protocol on a KingFisher APEX system.

The KingFisher APEX was programmed to perform sequential washing (3× with 80% ethanol) and digestion (37°C, 3.5 h) in 100 μL of TEAB buffer containing 0.5 μg Trypsin Gold (Mass Spectrometry Grade, dissolved in 50 mM triethylammonium bicarbonate (TEAB, Thermo Fisher Scientific)).
